outcome: Uterine artery Doppler flow pulsatility indices (UtA-PI)
cohort: 52 pregnant women (28 normotensive and 24 with stage-1 essential hypertension) with singleton pregnancies
finding: Women with chronic stage-1 hypertension showed progressively increasing postpartum uterine artery impedance, similar to normotensive women but with a significantly higher magnitude.
